title: fix(mcp,runtime): get_record_context reads a package's context packs on both MCP doors
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBEaJzgBWzjWCNjBjkVoeRto)_

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzi13yZRqVcp2mGonWK

Fixes #37243
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：部署了资料包的应用里，AI 助手读取一条记录的资料时（网页通道和本地命令行通道都一样），终于能读到资料包，不再一律回答“找不到资料包”。
- 为什么做：属于“AI 读取记录资料”这条能力（资料包设计）的缺陷修复，替所有提供资料包的部署（含演示应用）解决读不到的问题，另外两张卡也在等它。
- 出错会怎样：只影响 AI 读取记录资料这一个工具；若有问题，表现仍是读不到资料包，与修复前相同，可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无

## What changes
- **Both record-context doors hand the executor the authored packs, not the serving envelope.** The HTTP door (`packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts`, `listContextPacks` in the bridge's record-context members) and the stdio door (`packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts`, `listContextPacks`) read the protocol's served `ai_context` listing, which `decorateMetadataItem` stamps with `_diagnostics`; the executor's closed `AiContextSchema` parse (`parsedContextPacks`) dropped every row. Each door now maps its listing through `stripReadDecorations` (`@objectstack/spec/kernel`), the metadata-fallback branch included.
- **Which keys the strip removes, and why.** Exactly `METADATA_READ_DECORATIONS` (`_diagnostics`, `_draft`, `_withheldFields`, `_relatedListsArrangement`), the read path's derived keys that are no part of a document. The ADR-0010 protection envelope (`_packageId`, `_packageVersion`, `_provenance`, `_lock`, `_lockReason`, `_lockSource`) stays: `AiContextSchema` declares it through `MetadataProtectionFields`, so it parses, and the pin asserts the served pack still carries `_packageId`. A blanket underscore strip would remove declared keys; stripping only `_diagnostics` would leave the next listed decoration to fail the same way.
- **No new helper.** The shared helper already exists where producer and consumers meet: `spec/kernel/metadata-read-decorations.ts`, whose module docblock names this exact failure class ("any re-parse of a served document"). Both doors already depend on `@objectstack/spec`, so neither takes a new runtime dependency, and the protocol's served read (with its per-type redaction) is still the one a door reads — `getMetaItemsForExecution` would have dropped the `_diagnostics` too, but its docblock forbids reading it from a door that answers a caller.
- **The door's contract** is stated on `RecordContextDoor.listContextPacks` (`packages/services/service-record-context/src/door.ts`). The executor's strict parse is unchanged.

## Tests
- `packages/mcp/src/mcp-record-context-tools.test.ts`: new top-level `describe` — a real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` over a real `ObjectQL` (an in-memory SQLite `SqlDriver` store) with a package carrying the pack; the metadata service lists no pack, so the protocol's listing is the only one. Precondition asserts the served pack carries `_packageId` and `_diagnostics`; then `get_record_context` answers through the pack, identically on MCP-over-HTTP and stdio.
- `packages/runtime/src/mcp-record-context-tools-bridge.test.ts`: new top-level `describe` — the `/mcp` route end to end (`HttpDispatcher.handleMcp`, the real `MCPServerRuntime`, the real executor, `SecurityPlugin`, the real protocol over `ObjectQL` + `SqlDriver`); same precondition, then the call answers the pack's fields.
- Ablation (once each, then restored; restore proven by `git diff HEAD` empty and blob == HEAD): removing the strip at either door turns its pin red with the defect's own answer, `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` "No context pack named … reads object …".
- Test deps: `@objectstack/mcp` gains devDeps `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/driver-sql`; `@objectstack/runtime` gains devDeps `@objectstack/mcp` and `@objectstack/service-record-context`; each new value import has an anchored source alias row in that package's `vitest.config.ts` (`check:test-source-alias`).

## Acceptance notes
- Placement differs from the dataset tools on purpose: `service-analytics`' dataset executor strips decorations inside the executor; this card's ruling puts the strip at the doors and keeps `AiContextSchema`'s consumer strict. Noted, not changed.
- Wall time, single-file cold runs on a shared box: the runtime harness file was 16.7 s before this PR and 18.3 s after (import-dominated, cases ~0.2 s); the mcp harness file 5.8 s before and 10.8–14.1 s after, nearly all of it transforming `metadata-protocol` source through the new alias. These readings come from single-file runs. A full-package run shares the transform cost across files.

## Verification
<details><summary>Local readings (final head in the report)</summary>

See the report comment on #37243 for the exact commands, exit codes and the head sha they were read on.
</details>

**Read first:** `packages/mcp/src/stdio-data-bridge.ts` (`listContextPacks`, the strip on both branches), `packages/runtime/src/domains/mcp.ts` (same), `packages/mcp/src/mcp-record-context-tools.test.ts` (the precondition that makes the pin non-vacuous).

**Two-minute check:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/mcp-record-context-tools.test.ts` → 11 passed; delete `.map(stripReadDecorations)` from the stdio `listContextPacks` and the last case fails with `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`.
